[b][color=#fff2cc][size=5]☽ ☆ Installation ☆ ☾[/size][/color][/b]
⚘ The furniture.xnb goes into your [i]Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\TileSheets[/i] folder 
[color=#fce5cd][size=1]* ~ furniture.ja-JP if you play the game in Japanese) & (furniture.zh-CN if you play the game in Chinese.~ *[/size]
[size=3]( Please don't forget to make a backup! )[/size][/color]

[color=#fce5cd]⚘[/color] Rename the bed to farmhouse_tiles after choosing which version you want (3 versions to choose from blue, purple and red) then place the farmhouse_tiles.xnb in the assigned folders, into your Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content and Maps folder.

[color=#fce5cd]⚘[/color] After choosing which version kids bed you want (3 versions to choose from blue, purple and red) then place the townInterior.xnb in the assigned folders, into your Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content and Maps folder.[/font][font=Georgia]

[color=#fce5cd]⚘[/color] If you want to use the Content Patcher version, you need [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[color=#fce5cd]⚘[/color] Download the optional file (only the optional one!) and place it in your mods folder. [i]Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/i]
